message: The family group chat during a storm warning is quite the spectacle. It starts with my brother’s unsolicited weather updates, followed by my mom asking if we have enough snacks, and ends with my kids debating which board game is the most ‘storm-worthy.' By the time the skies clear, I realize that preparing for the weather is easier when you do it together — and with a little humor, of course. What’s your go-to family storm activity?
